Consider the following statements regarding Ashoka:
1. The definition of Dhamma given by Ashoka has been taken from the "Rahulovada-Sutta".
2. In the 14th year of his reign, Ashoka appointed a new type of staffcalled Dhamma-Mahamatras.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
Who established 'Rajdharma' on triplex bases of longanimity, liberty and compassion?
